name: Kearny Commons
summary: Kearny Commons is a community shopping center in Kearny, New Jersey, featuring a diverse mix of fitness, discount retail, beauty, and dining options including LA Fitness, Marshalls, Ulta Beauty, and Starbucks. This convenient one-stop destination serves the local community with essential everyday services and value-oriented shopping in an accessible location along Passaic Avenue.
demographics: Kearny Commons attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic from the densely populated Kearny and surrounding Hudson County areas, including young families and working professionals seeking convenient, value-oriented shopping. The trade area serves a predominantly suburban population with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, drawn to the center's mix of fitness, discount retail, and everyday services. Typical visitors are budget-conscious shoppers aged 25-55 who prioritize one-stop convenience for groceries, fitness, beauty products, and quick dining options, reflecting the practical needs of the working-class communities in this northern New Jersey corridor.
description: Kearny Commons is a vibrant community shopping center strategically located at 175 Passaic Avenue in the heart of Kearny, New Jersey, serving as an essential retail hub for Hudson County residents. This well-anchored retail destination brings together a carefully curated mix of national retailers and service providers that cater to everyday lifestyle needs, including LA Fitness for health and wellness, Marshalls for discount fashion and home goods, Ulta Beauty for cosmetics and personal care, and Starbucks for coffee and casual dining. The center's tenant lineup reflects a smart combination of fitness, value shopping, beauty services, banking, and quick-service dining options, making it a true one-stop destination for busy families and professionals. With its convenient location along Passaic Avenue and ample parking, Kearny Commons has established itself as a go-to shopping destination for the local community, offering the perfect blend of national brands and essential services in an accessible, open-air format. The property is professionally managed by Urban Edge Properties, a leading retail real estate company committed to maintaining high-quality shopping environments throughout the New York metropolitan area.
